claims.text: Argo CD applies a later sync wave only after the resources of the earlier wave, including Sync hooks, have completed successfully and are healthy; a failed hook stops the sync.

claims.text: HTTPRoute api (httproutes.yaml L17-39): rule 1 PathPrefix /api/v1, /api/v2, /openapi -> api:8080, so without rule 2 /api/v1/refunds reaches the api; rule 2 /api/v1/refunds -> payments:8080. Caddy is the reverse proxy of docker-compose.yml.
claims.source_hint: examples/don-hang deploy/gitops/config-repo/platform/edge/httproutes.yaml lines 17-39 at stage-3; docker-compose.yml L53 (caddy)

claims.text: When several HTTPRoute rules match a request, Gateway API gives precedence to the longest matching path (by characters) regardless of rule order, so /api/v1/refunds goes to payments, not to the /api/v1 rule.
claims.source_hint: gateway-api.sigs.k8s.io: API reference HTTPRouteRule (matches: precedence, 'Longest' path match); kubernetes.io Gateway API concepts

claims.text: The official postgres image runs the files in /docker-entrypoint-initdb.d only when it starts with an empty data directory; with an existing database it skips initialization (statefulset-db.txt: 'Database directory appears to contain a database; Skipping initialization').
claims.source_hint: Docker Hub postgres image docs: Initialization scripts; base/db.yaml L48-52 comment; outputs/stage-3/scripts/k8s/statefulset-db.txt

claims.text: Before the StatefulSet, db kept its data only inside the Pod (emptyDir), so every new Pod started empty and was seeded again; the StatefulSet's claim data-db-0 is mounted again by every replacement db-0 and is not deleted by a sync or a Pod deletion.
claims.source_hint: kubernetes.io: Volumes > emptyDir; StatefulSets > Stable Storage; base/db.yaml L1-5 comment

claims.text: With selfHeal, Argo CD reverts a live change such as kubectl scale back to the state in Git; setting spec.syncPolicy.automated to null disables automated sync (and so self-heal) for the Application; applying apps/staging.yaml again restores it.
claims.source_hint: argo-cd docs: User Guide > Automated Sync Policy (Automatic Self-Healing); stateful-staging.sh L61-64, L83-85

claims.text: Deleting a StatefulSet Pod makes the controller create a replacement with the same name that mounts the same PersistentVolumeClaim (data-db-0, data-rabbitmq-0).
donhang-staging has one node; kind's default StorageClass standard (local-path) keeps each volume in a folder on that node, so deleting the cluster deletes the volumes and their data.
